claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo once, wait for the service worker, go offline, reload

claim: Demo use and new share links keep lesson text out of HTTP requests
where: privacy section, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a fragment share link from /demo, open it, and assert lesson text is absent from all request URLs and referrers

claim: Demo sample data and changes are not saved to the real draft
sandbox: seed the real local-storage key, edit and reset /demo, assert the real key is unchanged

claim: Exports a valid lesson card as SVG or PNG
where: editor actions, first-screen facts, and README
sandbox: use /demo and assert SVG content plus PNG signature and file size

claim: A copied share link restores the exact lesson text
where: editor action, how-it-works section, and README
sandbox: copy the /demo link, open it in the clean context, and compare all syntax

claim: Validation names the invalid lesson field and blocks export
where: editor status, how-it-works section, and README
sandbox: enter invalid frets and capo in /demo; assert named errors and no download

claim: The optional worksheet pack exports four cards on one SVG sheet
sandbox: use the sample-only worksheet preview in /demo; assert four card titles in the SVG

claim: A returned valid license activates the worksheet pack on this browser
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept the documented billing verification response for a returned license and assert stored token, stripped URL, and worksheet activation

claim: The advertised $9 worksheet pack opens the hosted checkout
sandbox: request the production billing checkout endpoint without following redirects; assert its 303 redirect targets a Dodo hosted checkout session
